articles.title: Magawa the Hero Rat Immortalized in Stone
articles.summary: A giant pouched rat named Magawa, who sniffed out over 100 landmines in Cambodia, now has a seven-foot statue in Siem Reap.

articles.title: 17-Year-Old Sienna Toohey Shatters Leisel Jones' Age Record
articles.summary: Sienna Toohey swam 1:05.97 in the 100m breaststroke, breaking Leisel Jones' 17-year-old age record and becoming Australia's fastest post-supersuit swimmer.

articles.title: SEVENTEEN's V8 Sub-Unit Drops Debut EP with Pharrell Williams
articles.summary: The 8 and Vernon of SEVENTEEN form V8, releasing their self-titled debut EP on June 29, featuring production by Pharrell Williams and other big names.
